hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The `afterInitialize` callback is a no-op (returns the selector only). A separate `initializePools()` function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract and records the resulting initial tick on-chain.
